fields.scope: LoggingExtensions (ArgentSea.Shared/src/LoggerExtensions.cs) — all static readonly Action/Func event and scope delegate fields and their one-time assignment in the static constructor.
fields.statement: Every event-emitting member of LoggingExtensions is backed by a delegate created exactly once, in the type's static constructor, via LoggerMessage.Define or LoggerMessage.DefineScope; invoking that compiled delegate when its own configured level is disabled costs only the delegate's internal enabled-check, never message formatting or allocation. Members that do expensive work before reaching that check first guard it with IsEnabled at the delegate's own level: the ExpressionTreeCreatedEvents family at Debug, the command-execution timing events at Trace, and NullShardChildArguments at Information before it formats the ShardKey's string form.
